heading: INT. DEBTORS' PRISON WARD, LONDON - 1788 - NIGHT

units.text: INT. DEBTORS' PRISON WARD, LONDON - 1788 - NIGHT
A vaulted brick cell lit by a single tallow candle.
Straw on the stones.
A barred window, a crust of ice on the sill.
Water drips somewhere in the walls.
Four prisoners share the space.
EZEKIEL PRIMROSE-ADEBAYO (60s, once a draper, now a coat of patches) lies on a plank bed with a ledger on his chest.
The young JEMIMA HARGREAVES-OKORO (20s, ragged dress, hair under a cap) sits by the candle, darning a stocking.
The old soldier SERGEANT MAGNUS FALKENBERG (50s, one leg, a crutch) leans against the wall whittling a spoon.
In the shadows, the child TOBIAH (8, barefoot, a ratty blanket over his shoulders) listens.
They say the King is mad again.
units.name: EZEKIEL

units.text: They said so in 'eighty-eight.
units.name: MAGNUS

units.text: They said so in 'eighty-seven.
units.name: EZEKIEL

units.text: He'll be mad till he's dead.
units.name: MAGNUS

units.text: Hush. The boy.
units.name: JEMIMA

units.text: I'm not asleep.
units.name: TOBIAH

units.text: You should be.
units.name: JEMIMA

units.text: It's too cold.
units.name: TOBIAH

units.text: Magnus sets down the spoon, shuffles on his crutch to the boy, and wraps the blanket tighter, tucking it under the child's heels.
Ezekiel closes the ledger and sits up, grunting.
Jemima bites off her thread and holds the stocking out to Tobiah, who pulls it over a bare foot.
For a moment all four are close in the candlelight, the soldier kneeling, the draper leaning, the girl smiling at the child, and the child staring back at all of them as if memorizing their faces.
Tomorrow it will be warmer.
units.name: MAGNUS

units.text: Is that a promise?
units.name: TOBIAH

units.text: It's a weather report.
units.name: MAGNUS

units.text: From who?
units.name: TOBIAH

units.text: From the Almighty. He writes to me.
units.name: MAGNUS

units.text: Tobiah giggles.
Jemima shakes her head.
Ezekiel lies back down.
Then ask Him about the bailiff.
units.name: EZEKIEL
